concepts.name: Artificial_Intelligence
concepts.label: Artificial Intelligence
concepts.description: The simulation of human intelligence processes by machines, especially computer systems. These processes include learning, reasoning, and self-correction.

concepts.name: Machine_Learning
concepts.label: Machine Learning
concepts.description: A subset of AI that provides systems the ability to automatically learn and improve from experience without being explicitly programmed.

concepts.name: Deep_Learning
concepts.label: Deep Learning
concepts.description: A subset of machine learning based on artificial neural networks with representation learning. It can be supervised, semi-supervised or unsupervised.

concepts.name: Natural_Language_Processing
concepts.label: Natural Language Processing
concepts.description: A subfield of AI focused on the interaction between computers and humans through natural language. The goal is to enable computers to understand, interpret, and generate human language.

concepts.name: Computer_Vision
concepts.label: Computer Vision
concepts.description: A field of AI that trains computers to interpret and understand the visual world. Using digital images and deep learning models, machines can accurately identify and classify objects.

concepts.name: Large_Language_Model
concepts.label: Large Language Model
concepts.description: A type of AI model trained on vast amounts of text data to understand and generate human-like text. LLMs are the foundation of modern chatbots and AI assistants.

concepts.name: Neural_Network
concepts.label: Neural Network
concepts.description: A computing system inspired by biological neural networks. It consists of interconnected nodes (neurons) that process information using connectionist approaches.

concepts.name: Transformer
concepts.label: Transformer
concepts.description: A deep learning architecture that uses self-attention mechanisms. Transformers are the basis for models like GPT, BERT, and other modern language models.

concepts.name: Reinforcement_Learning
concepts.label: Reinforcement Learning
concepts.description: An area of machine learning where an agent learns to make decisions by performing actions and receiving rewards or penalties.

concepts.name: Generative_AI
concepts.label: Generative AI
concepts.description: AI systems capable of generating new content including text, images, audio, and video based on patterns learned from training data.

concepts.name: OpenAI
concepts.label: OpenAI
concepts.description: An American artificial intelligence research laboratory. OpenAI created ChatGPT and the GPT series of language models.

concepts.name: xAI
concepts.label: xAI
concepts.description: An artificial intelligence company founded by Elon Musk. xAI developed Grok, an AI assistant, and operates Grokipedia.

concepts.name: Anthropic
concepts.label: Anthropic
concepts.description: An AI safety company that develops Claude, a large language model designed to be helpful, harmless, and honest.

concepts.name: Google_DeepMind
concepts.label: Google DeepMind
concepts.description: An AI research laboratory that created AlphaGo, AlphaFold, and Gemini. Known for breakthrough research in deep learning and reinforcement learning.

concepts.name: ChatGPT
concepts.label: ChatGPT
concepts.description: An AI chatbot developed by OpenAI based on the GPT architecture. It can engage in conversational dialogue and assist with various tasks.

concepts.name: Claude
concepts.label: Claude
concepts.description: An AI assistant developed by Anthropic. Claude is designed to be helpful, harmless, and honest, with a focus on safety and reliability.

concepts.name: Grok
concepts.label: Grok
concepts.description: An AI assistant developed by xAI. Grok is known for its wit and willingness to answer provocative questions.

concepts.name: Grokipedia
concepts.label: Grokipedia
concepts.description: An AI-generated online encyclopedia operated by xAI. Articles are generated by Grok, making it the first major AI-generated encyclopedia.

concepts.name: Alan_Turing
concepts.label: Alan Turing
concepts.description: British mathematician and computer scientist, considered the father of theoretical computer science and AI. Created the Turing Test.

concepts.name: Geoffrey_Hinton
concepts.label: Geoffrey Hinton
concepts.description: British-Canadian cognitive psychologist and computer scientist, known as a 'Godfather of AI'. Pioneer in deep learning and neural networks.

concepts.name: Turing_Test
concepts.label: Turing Test
concepts.description: A test of a machine's ability to exhibit intelligent behavior indistinguishable from a human. Proposed by Alan Turing in 1950.

concepts.name: AI_Safety
concepts.label: AI Safety
concepts.description: A research field focused on making AI systems safe, beneficial, and aligned with human values. Addresses risks from advanced AI systems.
